shared_elements: a single dominant anthropomorphic figure filling the field
elaborate headdress/crest of ornament above the head
dense curl or scroll motifs used as decorative infill
raised-relief carving of a figure with attached wing-like or panel-like appendages
justification: Both show one large ornamented anthropomorphic figure that fills the carved field, with a crest of ornament above the head and dense curl/scroll infill, but these are generic features any relief tradition could arrive at. The depicted content differs fundamentally: A is a strict-profile bird-headed winged being with long feather registers and an extended arm, while B is a frontal, symmetrical standing human in a towering headdress with vertically stacked mask-like panels, with no wings and no profile orientation.
